title: 第544章 圣光与本源第543章 图腾本腾
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
第544章圣光与本源
“嗡……！”
低沉的阵法启动声，突然从第四层那根雪狼石质图腾内部响起。
图腾表面的氏族纹路一条接着一条亮起。
狼首双眼最先泛出灰白光芒。
紧接着是嘴角獠牙、脖颈毛发，还有一路延伸到图腾底座的粗糙纹路。
光芒钻入开裂的白色石砖。
沿着缝隙向外扩散。
不远处，撞穿冷餐长桌的鹰羽图腾跟着亮起。
近百根分散在七层台地上的氏族图腾，按照某种固定顺序依次产生反应。
若是此刻能从高处俯视整座圣·佩德罗，能够清楚看见一道道灰白光纹正在不同台地之间连接。
道路、石阶、升降轨道与嵌入悬崖的建筑，全都成了法阵的一部分。
那些纹路不断向上攀升。
最后在第六层汇聚。
一座覆盖整座城池的巨型图腾法阵，完整地出现在了七层台地上。
【瞳术·先见之明】
在维克多视界中光明教会圣职者体内的金白色圣光，此刻像是遇到了一股无法抵抗的吸力，被强行从他们体内抽了出来。
这些力量原本安静流动在他们血肉、魔力池和神魂之间。
“呃……”
第三层巡礼广场上，一名正在维持神术屏障的年轻牧师身体一晃。

神术屏障跟着闪烁起来。
明亮的金色表面出现大片暗斑。
笼罩普通信众的护罩变得越来越薄。
最后伴随着一声轻响，直接熄灭。
失去支撑的牧师双膝一软。
手中法杖撞在地上。
他想重新站起来，手臂却像是失去了全部力气，只能用手肘勉强撑住身体。
类似的景象出现在七层台地的每一个角落。
圣骑士长剑上的辉光快速褪去。
金白能量从剑身脱离，顺着持剑者的手臂倒流回胸口，然后被强行扯出。
猎魔人携带的圣水失去光泽。
瓶内原本明亮的液体，变得和普通清水没有多少区别。
五层台地修道院里，成片年轻圣职者接连倒下。
有人还想撑着盾牌站立。
可五根手指刚刚抓住盾沿，手臂便止不住地发抖。
圣职者常年接受圣光洗礼。
身体早已与圣光互为表里。
圣光之力不只是储存在身体里的能量。
content_en:
Chapter 544 Holy Light and Origin
"Buzz...!"
The low sound of the formation starting up suddenly sounded from inside the snow wolf stone totem on the fourth floor.
The clan lines on the surface of the totem light up one after another.
The wolf's eyes were the first to glow with grayish white light.
Then there are the fangs at the corners of the mouth, the hair on the neck, and the rough lines that extend all the way to the base of the totem.
Light penetrated the cracked white stone bricks.
Spread outward along the gaps.
Not far away, the eagle feather totem that crashed through the long buffet table lit up.
Nearly a hundred clan totems scattered on the seven-story platform react one after another in a certain fixed order.
If you can look down at the entire San Pedro from a high place at this moment, you can clearly see gray-white light patterns connecting different terraces.
Roads, stone steps, lift tracks and buildings embedded in the cliff have all become part of the magic circle.
Those lines keep climbing upwards.
Finally gathered on the sixth floor.
A giant totem array covering the entire city appeared completely on the seven-story platform.
[Pupillary Skills·Foresight]
In Victor's vision, the golden-white holy light in the bodies of the clergy of the Church of Light seemed to have encountered an irresistible suction force and was forcibly pulled out of their bodies.
These powers originally flowed quietly between their flesh and blood, magic pool and soul.
"Uh..."
On the third floor of the parade square, a young priest who was maintaining a magical barrier swayed.
The magical barrier flashed.
Large dark spots appear on the bright golden surface.
The shield surrounding ordinary believers is growing thinner.
Finally, with a soft sound, it went out.
The priest's knees buckled as he lost his support.
The staff in his hand hit the ground.
He wanted to stand up again, but his arms seemed to have lost all their strength, and he could only use his elbows to support his body.
Similar scenes appeared in every corner of the seven-story terrace.
The glow on the paladin's sword quickly faded.
The golden and white energy separated from the sword body, flowed back to the chest of the sword holder's arm, and was then forcibly pulled out.
The holy water carried by the witcher loses its luster.
The originally bright liquid in the bottle became no different from ordinary water.
In the five-story terraced monastery, scores of young clergymen fell one after another.
Some people even want to stand with a shield.
But as soon as his five fingers grasped the edge of the shield, his arm couldn't stop shaking.
Priests receive the baptism of the Holy Light all year round.
The body has long been intertwined with the Holy Light.
The power of Holy Light is not just energy stored in the body.
